description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Izzet Boilerworks onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Izzet Boilerworks trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
